title: IEEE S&P paper wins the Best Social Impact Award at CSAW 2026
summary: Our IEEE S&P 2026 paper, “Usable Anonymity in Reproductive Health Privacy,” received the Best Social Impact Award at the 2026 CSAW Applied Research Competition, which recognizes published security and privacy research for its technical and social impact. Qiurong Song presented the work at the finals at NYU. Congratulations to Qiurong, Lindy, and their collaborators!
details: Usable Anonymity in Reproductive Health Privacy — Qiurong Song, Yanlai Wu, Rie Helene (Lindy) Hernandez, Yao Li, Yubo Kou, and Xinning Gui
